title: Enter the Week With New Eyes
headline: How to Love Difficult People (Without Forcing It)
headline_sub: Enter the Week With New Eyes
tagline: When Christ changes your vision, love is no longer something you force. It becomes something you naturally bear.
seo_title: How to Love Difficult People: John 15:12 and Abiding | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Don't simply ask God to help you love difficult people. Ask Him to help you see them through His eyes. A short devotional on John 15:12.
verse_text: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.

scriptures.text: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.

items: Before entering the new week, remember that the goal is not simply to become more patient.
The goal is to remain more deeply connected to Christ.
Because fruit is never the result of self-effort.
Fruit is always the result of abiding.
As you remain in the Vine…. He transforms your heart.
As your heart is transformed…. your vision changes.
As your vision changes…. your relationships change.
As your relationships change…. Christ becomes visible through your life.
This is how image-bearers become easier to recognize.
but because Jesus has changed the one who is looking.
This week, don’t simply ask God to help you love difficult people.
Ask Him to help you see them through His eyes.
You may not be able to change every difficult person you encounter this week.
But by remaining in Christ, He can change the way you see every person you encounter.
The greatest evidence that Christ is transforming your life is not simply that you know more about Him….
it’s that you begin seeing people more like He does.
